final_note: You walked through reduction with carbon, electrolysis and reversible reactions.

walkthroughs.body_html:
K, Na, Ca, Mg, Al, C, Zn, Fe, H, Cu, Ag, Au.

Metals less reactive than carbon (Zn -> Au) can be reduced with carbon.

More reactive metals (above C) need electrolysis.

Fe2O3 + 3CO -> 2Fe + 3CO2.

Iron oxide is reduced (loses oxygen); CO is oxidised.

A ⇌ B means reaction goes both ways.

At equilibrium concentrations are constant but reactions continue.
